concept: ERC-4626 vault inflation attack: a donation to an empty vault skews the share price so the first depositor receives zero shares
scene: A minimal technical card on a deep navy background. A simple vault outline holds a single amber share token, while an arrow labeled as a direct token transfer drops into the vault from the side. Clean line work, a calm and precise engineering look, with plenty of empty space for the overlay text.
alt_text: Navy card with an amber outline of a vault holding one share token, with a direct transfer arrow entering the vault, and the text rounds down to zero shares.
